contexts.text: In place of spiritual temptations, there are... sicknesses of body... which in some measure subdue and break his life of pleasures and cupidities, and elevate his thoughts to interior and pious things.
In sicknesses and diseases, corporeal and worldly things being lulled, they perceive something of heavenly light and of comfort thence.
(The sick a class of the good in the Ancient Church.) AC 7260.
No confidence, except apparent in sicknesses of mind or body, when cupidities cease.
Like a weak and sickly body, which is to be restored to health by painful means.
They visit the sick and the simple in order to obtain wealth. Described.
I was sick and ye visited me... The sick = those who acknowledge that in themselves there is nothing but evil.
One sick = one who is in evil.
Who does not comfort a sick person [by the assurance that] he will shortly come into the other life.
Thy father is sick () = what is successive of regeneration. Hence to be sick, which precedes death, = what is progressive towards regeneration.
The Angels know nothing about sickness; and therefore when it is read of by man, they have an idea of the continuation of life... and also of regeneration, for this is resurrection into life.
Man himself... thinks of death, and the sickness which precedes it, as being resurrection into life...
Evils and falsities... induce sicknesses of mind.
These, before the merely natural, appear weak and sick in spirit.
Truths and goods done in a state of sickness...
The spiritual life is sick when...
When the taste commands, the body is sick.
Disease and sickness = the infirmity of the internal man...
Confidence, called faith, when they are sick.
When (truths and goods) are falsified and perverted, the man is sick...
Therefore the sick were anointed with oil. AE 375:43.
The healing of the sick = the purification of man from evils and the falsities of evil.
When they lie sick in bed... they believe they will live immediately after death.
When sick he thinks that Heaven is of pure mercy.
When this heat inflows into the sick, it excites insanities.
No one is reformed in a state of sickness of mind. Explained.
When the body is sick, the mind is sick. Explained.
Jealousy from various sicknesses of the mind.
They who do not explore themselves are like a sick person...
Therefore the sick who ascribe the restoration of their health to the Lord, speak truly.
Spirits from such Hells are not present with the sick; but there is a general sphere and influx from such heats which is at once adopted by the disease itself.
The sick are those who are distressed by evils and falsities, and they are to be visited, by some who bring comfort, and by others who bring a remedy.
Under Disease, see this reference.
Such Spirits sometimes come to sick men, causing their death.
A sick person = those who have transgressed and sinned; and therefore the Lord said to the sick man... Sin no more...
